title: Edit
expectedInputs: You get: a video you cut on a timeline, with an agent that proposes every change as a card you Keep, Undo, or Tweak.
openProjectHint: Open a project to talk to the editor.

timeline.hints: snap: frame · S split · Del delete

cards.reviewBody: Scrub the full timeline or confirm it looks good.

generate.needsKey: Add a {gateway} gateway key in {settings} to generate.
generate.animateStillClip: Animate the image clip under the playhead
generate.stillUrlPlaceholder: Still image URL, or move the playhead onto an image clip

guide.subject-action-timeline: Start with subject and action; describe multiple actions in timeline order.
guide.camera-move-names: Name the camera move: push, pull, pan, circle, follow, rise, zoom, or tracking.
guide.shot-size-names: Name the shot size: long, full, medium, close-up, macro, aerial, low or high angle.
guide.style-words: Use style words such as voxel, felt, clay, or manga for stylized output.
guide.prompt-order: Order the prompt as subject, movement, environment, camera movement, aesthetic, then sound.
guide.camera-start-end: Describe camera as starting composition, movement, amplitude, then ending composition.
guide.dialogue-quotes: Put dialogue in quotes and state emotion, tone, and pace.
guide.one-move-per-shot: Use one camera move per shot; label shots Shot 1, Shot 2, Shot 3.
guide.no-text-constraint: Add constraints such as avoid generating text or subtitles, and no logo or watermark.
guide.negatives-audio: Use negatives only for subtitles or audio, for example No subtitles or No BGM.
guide.camera-presets: Camera preset names work as prompt phrases: crash zoom in, dolly in, 360 orbit, whip pan.

recipes.hint: Each step becomes its own card after Go.
